shim: score_oracle.py installs a minimal gevent.lock.RLock substitute because Scoring reaches it transitively through cmsranking.Store; the real service needs the full gevent stack
corrects: The hand-derived draft of seed.json claimed /history carried a change to 0.0 for u1/t0. Score.append_change only appends when the computed score differs from the current one, so no such entry exists.
decimals: Floats are written with a decimal point on purpose: this file records what the Python scorer printed, and a reader must be able to tell 100.0 (a score) from 100 (an integer field).

score_modes.max: max of the submission scores, defaulting to 0.0 when there are none; a negative score survives
score_modes.max_subtask: element-wise max over each submission extra list (or [score] when it is empty), summed
score_modes.max_tokened_last: max of NumberSet.query() over the released scores and the last submission score; query() is max(values + [0.0]) so it never goes negative
